messages:
Asha: Heads-up: AltoTech (partner integrator) sent two urgent asks — can we accelerate a shared POC tenant for a joint demo next Wed, and they need clarity on pilot pricing (hosted vs dedicated). They also dropped a security questionnaire.

Miguel: I can own the activation. Do we have a reusable shared sandbox or should we spin up an isolated scoped tenant for the demo?

Noah: We do have a spare shared tenant (shared-poc-2024) but it’s rate-limited and used by other partners. For a customer-facing demo I recommend an isolated tenant. I can provision one once I have the entitlement id, owner email, and SSO redirect URI.

Asha: Pilot targets: interactive chat (UI latency) + bulk embeddings for search. Rough volume: ~100k tokens/day and ~50k embeddings/day. Demo in 7 days.

Priya: Pricing note: for pilots we prefer hosted consumption with a partner pilot discount; Dedicated if they commit. I’ll sketch up two options (hosted with 10% partner pilot discount, or a 3-month committed credit for Dedicated migration within 90 days). Need expected throughput to finalize numbers.

Miguel: Perf ask — do they expect bursty chat or steady qps? For now propose: chat model (gpt-medium) targeting up to 50 concurrent qps with low-latency SLO, plus batched embeddings (embed-mini) for nightly indexing.

Asha: I asked Alto. They confirmed interactive bursts during the demo and daily embedding jobs. They also attached an infosec PDF with required SAML SP-initiated, SCIM group provisioning, and SOC2 evidence. Link: https://altofiles.example/alto-sec-qna.pdf

Sam: If it’s a standard vendor sec questionnaire we can usually turn it in 48 hours. Need SAML metadata XML, SCIM HTTPS endpoint, confirmation they won’t send PHI, and SOC2 report link. Also pen-test contact for scheduling.

Asha: Action: I’ll request SAML metadata, SCIM endpoint details, SOC2 link, and owner email (they said migrations@alto.com). Will push for CSV group sync as a fallback because SCIM mapping could add a day.

Noah: Provisioning snippet for infra (internal API):

```
curl -X POST "https://platform.redwood.dev/internal/tenants" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"altotech-poc","owner":"migrations@alto.com","entitlement":"partner_poc_shared_v2","quota":{"gpu_hours":120,"token_rate":200000}}'
```

Noah: Once created I’ll lock firewall to Alto’s 3 IP ranges (they’re listed in the PDF) and attach a pre-baked GPU pool with quantized images. ETA: 3-4 hours after I get owner email and confirm quota.

Miguel: Note on SCIM — full group sync requires claim mappings and test accounts; estimate +1 day. CSV user sync can be quick for a demo.

Priya: I’ll draft a one-pager commercial: SKU, partner pilot discount, what qualifies for Dedicated conversion, and an estimated cost range. Will post by EOD.

Sam: Security checklist items for this POC:
- Verify SAML SP metadata and enforce SP-initiated flow
- Confirm SCIM endpoint TLS + auth (Bearer or Basic) or accept CSV fallback
- SOC2 report URL or AICPA letter
- Confirm no PHI or regulated data in demo datasets
- Provide pen-test contact and schedule
- Enable tenant audit logs and provide read-only export or SIEM sink

Sam: We’ll also require that any service account keys be scoped and rotation-enabled.

Asha: Alto agreed to CSV fallback for the demo window; they’ll still send SCIM details for later. Owner email confirmed: migrations@alto.com. They also requested egress to three IP ranges — ok to add as scoped allowlist for 72 hours.

Noah: I’ll queue tenant creation with those params and the CIDR allowlist. Integration request queued (req-id will show). After creation I’ll attach a logging sink + read-only export role for their security team.

integration-bot: Tenant provisioning request queued (req-id: req_9f7c2). You will be notified on completion.

Miguel: Canary/perf plan (prelim):
- Deploy chat model with token limits and 95th percentile latency SLOs
- Configure embeddings batch size and off-peak indexing window
- Canary test with 50 synthetic users, ramp to 200 in 15m
- If latency > SLO, fallback to smaller model variant and enable caching
I’ll post exact config once tenant is live.

Priya: Scheduling: setting a 30-min technical presales call with Alto on Tuesday to walk through SSO, SCIM fallback, and pilot SLAs. Invite sent. :calendar:

Asha: Summary of action items:
- Asha: collect SAML metadata, SOC2 link, confirm owner + IPs, push CSV fallback (EOD tomorrow)
- Priya: pilot commercial one-pager (EOD)
- Sam: security checklist + pen-test contact (48hrs)
- Noah: provision tenant after owner confirmed (same day)
- Miguel: perf/canary config and fallback plan (once tenant up)

Noah: Will provision when I get the owner email confirmation and quota ack. If we hit infra rate limits we’ll fall back to the shared sandbox but prefer isolated tenant. :white_check_mark:

Miguel: I’ll post final perf checks and the canary playbook here after provisioning completes. :eyes:
